sourcePage.interpretation: Current page describes original-state museum display; photograph capture dates not supplied. Historical narrative does not establish complete present inventories.

sources.subject: 养心殿外檐匾额近景
sources.observations: Vertical Chinese/Manchu board, carved surround, painted beam and red glazed transom below. Not an overall front elevation; no full roof or bay-count acceptance.

sources.subject: 养心殿明间内景
sources.observations: Octagonal green/gold caisson and hanging lamp, central throne/screen, flanking blue-filled storage/display fronts, paired incense objects and side tables. Current S furniture remains an approximate inherited layer, not photo-matched inventory.

sources.subject: 养心殿东暖阁
sources.observations: Central west-facing seating, dark upper/yellow lower horizontal hanging fabric, rear blue-filled screens, south-window kang with yellow cushions, left joinery and floor carpet. Museum lamps and camera are visible; photo date unknown.

sources.subject: 西暖阁内壁画场景，精确房间待定位
sources.observations: A chair before landscape painting; left wall has a trompe-l’oeil circular scene and painted latticed windows. These are image planes, not proof of physical door/window openings or traversable rooms.

sources.subject: 勤政亲贤北墙炕
sources.observations: Readable 勤政亲贤 plaque. North-wall kang, cream shaped seat/two bolsters, two low kang tables, two separate tall outer floor stands, centered low dark footstool, wall hangings and carpet. Only this front-facing wall and furniture relation are covered.

sources.subject: 三希堂南窗炕
sources.observations: Readable 三希堂 plaque. Yellow seat with back at left/east, blue-covered kang, small reading desk, white large window casing, wall-mounted vases and floor-side wood cubes. Supports positive Sanxitang identification despite input register saying no confirmed photo; not whole-room coverage.

sources.subject: 养心门外立面
sources.observations: Readable 养心门 board. One glazed central gateway, lower flanking decorated screens, separate internal wooden screen behind, two bronze lions and lanterns, modern protective railings. Do not confuse with existing east-facing 遵义门.

sources.subject: 又日新匾下寝居场景，房间未定位
sources.observations: Left curtained bed niche, right window kang, dark joinery and white ceiling, hanging lanterns, rear table/clock. Generic page caption does not identify this as 随安室, 后殿, 体顺堂 or 燕禧堂; leave unassigned.

differences.name: Qinzheng centered low footstool

reference.visible: One low dark rectangular stool at floor level, centered immediately in front of the north-wall kang, with a top and short supporting base.

differences.current: R53 kang/seat and two low tables are present; no floor footstool is generated at its south edge. Decoded real S west half supplies floor/partition, not a duplicate stool.
differences.changeTarget: Add a minimal fitted wooden footstool to existing permanent west-room group. Retain asset bytes, all rooms, existing kang furniture, character counts and route. Exact carving and dimensions are not claimed.

boundedCheck.role: central low footstool immediately south of existing north-wall kang
boundedCheck.floorCaveat: Base .668 is 0.6 hall floor plus .068, just above retained decoded S plank top .667337. In B-only mode top support/base choice needs implementation-owner review, not visual acceptance.

differences.verify: Owner should check the final chosen dimensions against current complete B/S stage, route/colliders/walkables and matched before/after browser views. This audit only establishes source and bounded absence/fit; no visual pass.

differences.name: Qinzheng outer pair of floor stands

reference.visible: A pair of tall square dark floor stands outside the left/right ends of the kang, distinct from the two short tables standing on its red top.

differences.current: Only the short kang-top pair is implemented. No outer standing pair in R53 or decoded S.
differences.blocker: A literal fitted west stand just outside kang x13.25 would conflict with existing visitor route x14 z-3.2..-1.1; avoid adding a collision blocker or silently moving the established route.
differences.nextAction: Keep as known missing photo-supported furniture; determine a reversible fit and route solution in a later explicit geometry pass. Do not copy objects/vessels whose shape is not adequately resolved.
